output.reply: Two directions for this disposable fixture. Both use the supplied references as design inspiration and keep the prototype self-contained, with no libraries or external resources. Neither direction is selected.

options.title: Quiet glass
options.detail: A soft translucent panel with a large count and two labelled buttons. Borrows Lucide’s thin, consistent strokes and Motion’s restrained feedback through a brief button press effect.
options.test: Increment twice to reach 2, then reset to 0. Repeat using Tab and Enter; check that focus stays visible.

options.title: Gentle bounce
options.detail: A prominent count above two solid, readable buttons. Borrows Lucide’s simple plus and reset shapes and Motion’s spring-like response through a small CSS count pulse.
options.test: Increment twice, then reset, using mouse and keyboard. Check that the pulse never obscures the number and disappears with reduced motion enabled.
